name: International Federation of Surveyors
description: Federation of national associations representing surveyors worldwide, covering the full range of surveying disciplines.

name: International Society for Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
description: Non-governmental organisation advancing international cooperation in photogrammetry, remote sensing and spatial information sciences.

name: Open Geospatial Consortium
description: Member-driven consortium that develops open standards for geospatial content and location-based services.

name: International Hydrographic Organization
description: Intergovernmental organisation coordinating hydrographic activities and standards for safe navigation.

name: UN Committee of Experts on Global Geospatial Information Management
description: United Nations body setting the agenda for the development and use of global geospatial information.

name: International Association of Geodesy
description: Scientific organisation promoting research and cooperation in geodesy, including global reference frames.

name: Open Source Geospatial Foundation
description: Foundation supporting the collaborative development of open-source geospatial software and its community.

name: International Cartographic Association
description: Organisation promoting cartography and GIScience through research, education and international collaboration.

name: EuroGeographics
description: Association of European national mapping, cadastre and land registry authorities.

name: European Association of Remote Sensing Companies
description: Association representing European companies providing Earth observation-based geo-information services.

name: European Spatial Data Research
description: Network linking national mapping agencies with research institutes to address spatial data challenges.

name: Council of European Geodetic Surveyors
description: Body representing the geodetic surveying profession in Europe.

name: American Society for Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
description: Scientific association advancing imaging and geospatial information science and technology.

name: National Society of Professional Surveyors
description: National organisation representing the surveying profession in the United States.

name: URISA
description: Association for GIS professionals, with a focus on the use of spatial technology in government.

name: Surveying and Spatial Sciences Institute
description: Peak body for surveying and spatial science professionals in Australia.
